scores.method: score = 100 * sum(weight * status_value) / sum(weight) over checks whose status is PASS (1.0), WARNING (0.5) or FAIL (0.0). N/A and MANUAL REVIEW are excluded from both numerator and denominator. The two scores use disjoint check sets. A score of null means no check in that set produced scorable evidence.
